question: What type of unemployment will be generated by the agricultural sector in case when it employs additional labourers only for some time of the year like the harvest season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seasonal unemployment.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The scenario described in the question is a classic example of** seasonal unemployment.**
 
• It occurs when there is a predictable pattern of **employment and unemployment** in a particular sector or industry due to **seasonal changes or fluctuations** in demand.
 
• Agricultural sector is one of the most common industries where **seasonal unemployment occurs.**
 
• It is also known as** agricultural unemployment**, where farmers and other agricultural workers are employed only during the specific seasons like **harvesting, sowing, plowing, etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disguised unemployment **is a situation where more people are employed in a job than actually required.

 
 
• It is often seen in the agricultural sector where a large number of people work on a small piece of land, leading to **low productivity and low wages.**
 
 
 
• **Cyclical unemployment** occurs due to the fluctuations in the business cycle.
 
 
• It is caused by changes in the economic conditions, such as** recession, depression, or boom.**
 
 
 
• **Structural unemployment **occurs due to the changes in the structure of the economy.
 
 
• It happens when there is a mismatch between the **skills of the workers and the requirements of the jobs. **
